executiveSummary: Iteration 000007 delivers complete end-to-end upscale support across all system layers. All 7 FRs and 4 USs comply. Three minor observations from the compliance report were resolved in-place during the audit.
minorObservations: Playground visible hint when no upscale models are available — resolved.
_decode_source_image() error messages made actionable and user-friendly — resolved.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: All compliance gaps were observations only (non-blocking). All three have been addressed. Iteration 000007 is production-ready.
